title: Plane and Solid Geometry - Assessment Exam
instructions: Answer all 20 questions. You have 90 minutes. Show your work for full credit on short-answer questions.

questions.question: Two similar polygons have corresponding sides in the ratio 2:3. The smaller polygon has perimeter 30 cm. What is the perimeter of the larger polygon?
Two similar solids have volumes in the ratio 27:64. What is the ratio of their corresponding surface areas?
A sector of a circle with radius 6 cm has area 6π cm². What is the central angle of the sector?
Two concentric circles form an annulus with area 63π cm². If the outer radius is 10 cm, what is the inner radius?
A rectangular box has dimensions 3 cm × 4 cm × 12 cm. What is the length of its space diagonal?
A cone has radius 5 cm, height 12 cm, and slant height 13 cm. What is its total surface area?
A cube is inscribed in a sphere with radius 4 cm. What is the side length of the cube?
The interior angle of a regular polygon is 160°. How many sides does the polygon have?
A cylinder and a cone have the same radius r and height h. What is the ratio of the cylinder's volume to the cone's volume?
Two similar triangles have areas 36 cm² and 100 cm². If the smaller triangle has a side of length 9 cm, what is the length of the corresponding side in the larger triangle?
If the radius of a sphere is doubled, its volume increases by a factor of 8.
The sum of exterior angles of any convex polygon is always 360°.
A segment of a circle is larger in area than a sector with the same central angle.
A sphere inscribed in a cube with side 10 cm has radius 5 cm.
A circle has circumference 20π cm. The area of the circle is _____ cm². (Express your answer without π, e.g., 100)
A sphere has surface area 64π cm². The radius of the sphere is _____ cm.
The sum of interior angles of a 10-sided polygon is _____ degrees.
A cone has volume 48π cm³ and height 9 cm. Its radius is _____ cm.
Two similar rectangular boxes have volumes in the ratio 8:27. If the smaller box has dimensions 2 cm × 3 cm × 4 cm, find the volume of the larger box. Show your work.
questions.rubric: Award 5 points for correct answer (162 cm³) with clear explanation: volume ratio = 8:27 means linear ratio = 2:3, so volume of larger = 24 × (3/2)³ = 24 × 27/8 = 81... wait, this is wrong. Let me recalculate. 2×3×4 = 24 cm³. If ratio is 8:27, larger volume = 24 × 27/8 = 81 cm³.

questions.question: A circular sector has radius 10 cm and central angle 72°. Find the arc length and the area of the sector. Show your work.
questions.rubric: Award 5 points for correct answers: arc length = 4π cm, sector area = 20π cm² (with clear formulas used)
